#(
    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 64,
    parameter STG_WIDTH = 16
)
(
    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    input i_en,
    input [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] adda,
    input [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] addb,
    output reg [DATA_WIDTH:0] result,
    output reg o_en
);

reg [DATA_WIDTH:0] stage_reg [0:STG_WIDTH-1];
reg [DATA_WIDTH:0] carry;
integer i;

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        for (i = 0; i < STG_WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin
            stage_reg[i] <= 0;
        end
        result <= 0;
        o_en <= 0;
    end else if (i_en) begin
        stage_reg[0] <= {1'b0, adda} + {1'b0, addb}; // Initial addition
        for (i = 1; i < STG_WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin
            stage_reg[i] <= stage_reg[i-1]; // Propagate through stages
        end
        result <= stage_reg[STG_WIDTH-1]; // Final result
        o_en <= 1; // Output enable
    end else begin
        o_en <= 0; // Disable output if not enabled
    end
end

endmodule

   input clk, reset;
   input [7:0] a, b;
   output reg [15:0] p;

      if (reset) begin
         p <= 16'b0;

         multiplicand <= {8'b0, a}; // sign-extend a
         multiplier <= {8'b0, b}; // sign-extend b
         ctr <= 5'b0;
         state <= 0;
      end else begin
         case (state)
            0: begin // idle state
               if (ctr < 16) begin
                  state <= 1; // move to compute state
               end else if (ctr == 16) begin
                  state <= 2; // move to done state
               end
            end
            1: begin // compute state
               case ({multiplier[1:0]}) // Booth encoding
                  2'b01: p <= p + multiplicand; // add multiplicand

                  default: ; // do nothing

               multiplicand <= multiplicand << 1; // left shift multiplicand
               multiplier <= {multiplier[15:1], 1'b0}; // right shift multiplier
               ctr <= ctr + 1; // increment counter
               if (ctr == 15) begin
                  state <= 2; // if last cycle, move to done state
               end

            2: begin // done state
